'''Yosuke Akimoto''' ('''秋元羊介''' ''Akimoto Yōsuke'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Akimoto was born '''Yukio Tajika''' ('''田鹿幸雄''' ''Tajika Yukio'') on February 5, 1944 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He started his work on {{aniseries|PTS}} during the {{aniseries|OS}}, where he voiced [[Sabrina's father]]. In {{aniseries|RS}}, his role was [[Mr. Briney]]. However, his most prominent role was {{an|Dr. Fuji}} during [[M01|the first movie]] and its radio drama prequel [[The Birth of Mewtwo]].
